scenarios.title: Search asset by exact name
preconditions: Application is available and asset data is loaded
steps: Enter 'Sales Transactions' in the search input
scenarios.expectedResult: Exactly one matching row displays Sales Transactions.

scenarios.title: Search assets by partial name
preconditions: Application is available and asset data is loaded
scenarios.expectedResult: Customer Master is displayed as the matching asset.

scenarios.title: Search assets by owner name
preconditions: Application is available and asset data is loaded
steps: Enter 'Finance Data' in the search input
scenarios.expectedResult: Sales Transactions is displayed because its owner is Finance Data.

scenarios.title: Search for a non-existent asset or owner
preconditions: Application is available and asset data is loaded
scenarios.expectedResult: No asset rows are displayed and the status message says 'No assets match your search.'

scenarios.title: Search using a single character
preconditions: Application is available and asset data is loaded
scenarios.expectedResult: All four assets are displayed because each asset name contains the letter A, ignoring case.

scenarios.title: Search using a long query
preconditions: Application is available and asset data is loaded
scenarios.expectedResult: The application handles the long query without an application error and displays the no-results status.

scenarios.title: Search with leading and trailing whitespace
preconditions: Application is available and asset data is loaded
steps: Enter '  Sales Transactions  ' in the search input
scenarios.expectedResult: Whitespace is trimmed and exactly one Sales Transactions row is displayed.

scenarios.title: Search using mixed-case characters
preconditions: Application is available and asset data is loaded
steps: Enter 'sAlEs TrAnSaCtIoNs' in the search input
scenarios.expectedResult: Exactly one matching Sales Transactions row is displayed.
